name: Mechatronic
description: Builds a [color=#E92031]Redstone Monstrosity[/color], a walking war machine of stone and redstone. [color=#E92031]Monstrosity Mode[/color]: right click to summon it or use its Super Move, left click to give orders, Sneak + right click to recall it.

badge.name: Redstone Monstrosity
badge.description: Summons the [color=#E92031]Redstone Monstrosity[/color]: it draws enemies within 12 blocks. Left click a creature to attack, a block to hold; Sneak to follow. Rebuilt 60s after breaking down.

commons.name: Redstone Generator
commons.description: Blows charge it up. Full charge Overcharges it for 6s: a Cube Field blocks projectiles, +50% speed and damage, much stronger knockback.

commons.name: Saddle
commons.description: Right click it to ride. Left click: lift. Right click: Super Move. Hold Jump to charge a jump (a slamming leap while galloping); Jump in the air to rocket.

adept.name: Piston Arm
adept.description: Super Move: a two-fist piston slam, 14 damage within 4 blocks in front. Cooldown 6s.

adept.name: Dispenser Arm
adept.description: Super Move: a homing bolt from each arm cannon, 6 damage each. Cooldown 5s.

master.name: Ministrosities
master.description: Overcharging raises 3 Ministrosities from the ground to fight beside it.

master.name: Supercharged
master.description: While Overcharged, its blows arc to up to 3 more enemies within 5 blocks for 5 damage each, and it takes 30% less damage.

grandmaster.name: Rocket Boots
grandmaster.description: Rockets burn longer and climb harder: 2.4s of thrust.
